mediaLibrary.rule: Every image, screenshot, video, social layout and archive listed below is withdrawn from press, creator and social use unless its exact URL appears in approvedPublicDownloads.
mediaLibrary.reason: Authenticity alone did not make the earlier material understandable or attractive. Several captures had an unreadable or missing creature, weak composition, cluttered interface or a moment that did not demonstrate play.
mediaLibrary.replacementGate: A replacement needs one clear gameplay moment, a fully visible creature, clean framing, phone-size readability and frame-by-frame review by a named adult.

realCreatureShowcase.selectionBoundary: Selected from deliberately balanced engine runs to show visible range. This is not a probability sample, normal hatch odds or an absolute uniqueness claim.

creatorDownloadKit.contents: Withdrawn because the included game render and selected moments failed human visual review. Do not publish or share this archive.

signalLogFeeds.sourcePolicy: Both feeds are generated from the same checked live-release source as the public Signal Log. They contain no email signup, recipient collection or tracking parameters.

permissions: Assets not marked withdrawn may be used in truthful editorial coverage of Mythical Void with their descriptions and disclosures preserved.
restrictions: Only assets labelled authentic_running_build_screenshot may be described as gameplay screenshots.
The Forest video labelled authentic_running_build_story_moment must be described as an in-game story moment, not platforming or combat footage.
The branded social videos and creator kit are withdrawn and must not be published or shared.
The Mythical Forest phone frame and Village Heart builder frame are withdrawn from promotion because they failed human visual review.

Creature renderer exports may be described as authentic game-rendered creatures, but the branded twelve-creature proof layout is not a playable game scene and the selection must not be presented as normal hatch odds.
Do not present marketing illustrations or game-world artwork as gameplay footage.
Do not imply NASA endorsement or partnership.
Do not imply sentience, consciousness, global creature uniqueness or a fully autonomous studio.
